captures.scale_paragraph: The following is the list of food establishment inspection scores for the week ending 05/11/2024. Scores are based on a scale of zero to 100. A score of 90 to 100 is excellent; 80 to 89 is good; 70 to 79 is acceptable; and 60 to 69 is marginal. A score below 60 may be grounds for the closing of an establishment or other enforcement action.
